_predeclaration_note: run2 (2026-09-09, second real-data cycle, fixes the F4 process gap disclosed in v0.7.0's release notes): this file, split_manifest.json, and TOLERANCE_DECISION.md are committed in their OWN commit, BEFORE lab/run_real_system.py is invoked against test.jsonl for run2. Data (train/calibration/test.jsonl, split_manifest.json) is byte-identical to run 1 -- same frames, same objects, same ICP runs, same seeds -- so tolerance choice is the only varied factor. Tolerances below were RE-DERIVED from TRAIN-split achievable ICP accuracy only (never from calibration/test); see TOLERANCE_DECISION.md and lab/derive_tolerances_from_train.py for the full method, and tolerance_derivation.json for the exact numeric derivation. No calibration/test statistic was inspected before this commit.

backend.name: in-repo numpy+scipy point-to-point ICP/Kabsch (lab/bop_icp_backend.py)
backend.model_weights: none (no learned model; closed-form SVD/Kabsch rigid-transform update each iteration)
backend.note: Backend code (lab/bop_icp_backend.py, lab/adapter_bop.py) unchanged since run 1 (originally run against ed8735ad04c17efe1d1bc0a0cec4625071d2bdbb); this run2 config/tolerance-freeze commit is built on top of repository commit 2b251f951fbb57c7423b6abc7b2bf0f994b43bcd (parent of this file's own commit).

dataset.name: BOP LineMOD-Occlusion (LM-O) test_bop19 subset, scene 000002
dataset.frame_prefilter: frames dropped from the sampling pool if either object has fewer than 300 mask_visib pixels with a nonzero real depth reading (real sensor dropout / heavy occlusion), applied before any random draw
dataset.frame_draw: 60 frames drawn without replacement from the prefiltered pool, numpy Generator seed 20260909
dataset.frame_split: 60 drawn frames permuted (numpy Generator seed 20260909) and cut 20/20/20 into TRAIN/CALIBRATION/FINAL TEST; all episodes (both objects) from one frame land in exactly one split
dataset.independent_sampling_unit: frame (not object-episode): the true number of independent draws is 60 frames, split 20/20/20; the two per-frame object episodes share the same depth-noise realization and are therefore not treated as independent units by the split rule
dataset.object_segmentation: dataset-provided ground-truth mask_visib for the target object in each frame; no online detector/segmentation network is executed -- this experiment tests the REFINEMENT stage only, not detection/segmentation
dataset.initial_pose: documented bounded random perturbation of real ground truth (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:perturb_pose): translation += isotropic Gaussian noise sigma=15mm per axis; rotation = random-axis rotation with angle ~ Uniform[5,20] degrees composed with ground-truth rotation. This simulates a coarse detector stage; it is not a full autonomous detection pipeline.
dataset.ground_truth_orthonormalization: BOP cam_R_m2c matrices are not exactly orthonormal at float precision (observed residual up to ~3e-4); both ground-truth and estimated rotations are projected to the nearest proper rotation via SVD (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:orthonormalize) before oracle error computation, applied identically to both.

estimator_side_stopping_rule: two consecutive ICP stages with |delta_t| <= 0.5mm and |delta_r| <= 0.1deg (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:estimator_converged); if never satisfied within the 15-iteration budget, lab/run_real_system.py's estimator_index() falls back to the terminal stage
timing_mode_reason: incremental_ms is real measured per-iteration wall-clock (cKDTree query + Kabsch SVD), but no separate online_policy_measured dual-policy execution was run; a latency-reduction PASS is therefore deliberately disabled by this timing_mode, matching lab/README.md section 5/7
inference_caveat: minimum_test_episodes=30 and independent_sampling_unit=episode are reused unchanged from lab/config.example.json's evaluator field, which the public evaluator (lab/run_real_system.py) treats as one unit per JSONL row (40 test rows satisfy minimum_test_episodes=30). This is a WEAKER independence assumption than dataset.independent_sampling_unit=frame above (only 20 independent test frames), because the evaluator has no native concept of frame-level clustering; the discrepancy is reported explicitly rather than silently reconciled, and the true independent count for power purposes is 20 frames, not 40 episodes.
tasks_reused_note: task reader kind/mask unchanged from lab/config.example.json and from run 1's config.json; only the numeric per-component tolerance was replaced with a value derived from TRAIN-split achievable ICP accuracy (75th percentile of the estimator-convergence-stage absolute pose error across the 40 TRAIN episodes, rounded up to 1mm / 1deg grid -- see TOLERANCE_DECISION.md). Components a task's mask does not use keep the original 1e9 sentinel unchanged.
